Create ONE clean atlas with exactly 6 separate illustrations in an evenly spaced 3-column x 2-row grid. Match a cozy Korean anime RPG with coral-haired chibi heroes, warm brown clean outlines, navy capes, mint and cream clothes, golden stars. Soft polished cel shading, no pixel art, no text, no borders, no platform or ground shadow, no glow haze outside silhouettes. Readable at 42 pixels. No humans, no other objects, no accessories held in paws. Species and palette strictly consistent across all five pet cells. Egg and individual pets isolated with genuine transparent background.
